desc.p: Maps SNOMED CT vaccine products to the ATC classification. Source is the value set Vaccine Product extensional (SNOMED) (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.10), target eHDSIVaccines (ATC) (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.12). The map starts from SNOMED rather than from CVX so that SNOMED CT stays the one axis every other classification hangs off; the CVX codes reach ATC through the concept map CVX to SNOMED-CT Vaccine Products (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.24.3). equivalent means the ATC code names the same vaccine, wider means ATC is the coarser of the two. 20 rows, 11 equivalent, 9 wider. One row needs the ATC group code rather than a substance code: 2221000221107 is the target of both the varicella and the live zoster vaccine, which ATC separates into J07BK01 and J07BK02, so only the group J07BK stays true for either use. Three codes of the source table were corrected, see the comments on the rows.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only Streptococcus pneumoniae Danish serotype 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6B, 7F, 8, 9N, 9V, 10A, 11A, 12F, 14, 15B, 17F, 18C, 19A, 19F, 20, 22F, 23F, and 33F capsular polysaccharide antigens (medicinal product)
Vaccine product containing only Human alphaherpesvirus 3 recombinant surface glycoprotein E antigen (medicinal product)
Vaccine product containing only severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 encoding B lineage spike protein messenger ribonucleic acid (medicinal product)

target.comment: ATC does not separate the manufacturers or the lineage.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only adsorbed Hepatitis B virus recombinant surface antigen (medicinal product)
Pediatric vaccine product containing only adsorbed Hepatitis B virus recombinant surface antigen (medicinal product)

target.comment: ATC does not mark the paediatric presentation.

element.displayName: Pediatric vaccine product containing only acellular Bordetella pertussis and Clostridium tetani toxoid and Corynebacterium diphtheriae toxoid antigens (medicinal product)

target.displayName: pertussis, purified antigen, combinations with toxoids
target.comment: The source table stated J07AM01, which is tetanus toxoid alone. ATC files acellular pertussis combination vaccines under J07AJ52 and does not separate the paediatric DTaP from the adult Tdap.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only Neisseria meningitidis serogroup A, C, W135 and Y capsular polysaccharide conjugated antigens (medicinal product)

target.displayName: meningococcus A,C,Y,W-135, tetravalent purified polysaccharides antigen conjugated

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only Human papillomavirus 6, 11, 16 and 18 antigens (medicinal product)

target.comment: The source table stated J07BM02, which is the bivalent vaccine against types 16 and 18. The quadrivalent vaccine is J07BM01.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only Haemophilus influenzae type b capsular polysaccharide antigen conjugated (medicinal product)

target.displayName: haemophilus influenzae B, purified antigen conjugated

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only influenza A virus subtypes H1N1 and H3N2 and influenza B virus Victoria lineage antigens (medicinal product)

target.displayName: influenza, inactivated, split virus or surface antigen
target.comment: ATC classifies by preparation, not by valency; the trivalent composition is not represented.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only live attenuated Human alphaherpesvirus 3 antigen (medicinal product)

target.comment: This SNOMED concept is the target of both CVX 21 varicella and CVX 121 zoster live, which ATC separates into J07BK01 and J07BK02. The group code J07BK covers both and is the only target that stays true for either use.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only live attenuated Measles morbillivirus and Mumps orthorubulavirus and Rubella virus antigens (medicinal product)

target.displayName: measles, combinations with mumps and rubella, live attenuated

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only recombinant non-replicating viral vector encoding severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 spike protein (medicinal product)

target.comment: The source table stated J07BX03, which the target value set does not contain. The current ATC code for non-replicating viral vector COVID-19 vaccines is J07BN02.

element.displayName: Vaccine product containing only low dose acellular Bordetella pertussis and Clostridium tetani and low dose Corynebacterium diphtheriae antigens (medicinal product)

target.displayName: pertussis, purified antigen, combinations with toxoids
target.comment: The source table stated J07AM52, which is tetanus toxoid combined with tetanus immunoglobulin. ATC does not separate Tdap from DTaP; both carry J07AJ52.
